root_cause.text: The smb2_get_ksmbd_tcon function in the ksmbd subsystem omits validation of the t_state field when reusing work->tcon in compound requests, enabling access to freed share_conf memory after a prior SMB2_TREE_DISCONNECT command transitions the connection state to TREE_DISCONNECTED.
root_cause.evidence: The patch introduces a check `if (work->tcon->t_state != TREE_CONNECTED)` in smb2_get_ksmbd_tcon, correcting the oversight where the compound reuse path bypassed the t_state validation enforced by ksmbd_tree_conn_lookup().
